description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Registered_Function' which is responsible for compiling code related to executing registered functions within the Smarty templating engine. The class's compile method generates PHP code to invoke a registered plugin function with provided attributes, handling caching considerations and modifiers.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Registered_Function
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling PHP code to execute registered Smarty functions within templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to execute a registered Smarty plugin function with given attributes and handles cache settings and modifiers.
